title: Holmes playbook manifest
description: A declarative Holmes playbook. Describes when to fire and what to prepare. Runs on the draft only path behind the same tool filter as the built in playbooks.

id.description: Stable identifier. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Must not collide with a built in playbook.

icon.description: SF Symbol name. Defaults to sparkles.

kind.description: Which draft only persona writes the result. Defaults to aiAnswer.

composioApps.description: Composio app slugs whose read only tools should be offered, for example GITHUB. Send, delete and post tools are filtered out regardless.

apps.description: Case insensitive substrings of the active app name. Any one matches.

windowTitle.description: Regular expression the window title must match, case insensitive.

goal.description: Prompt template. The draft never send rule is appended automatically.

title.description: Review card title template. Defaults to name.

persona.description: Optional voice and shape guidance for the model. Holmes wraps it in a fixed draft only preamble, so it can narrow the output but never widen what the model may do.

mcpServers.description: Server names from mcp.json whose read only tools may be offered to this playbook. Each tool still needs readOnlyHint and a read shaped name.
